item.title: Daryl Hall Says Record Companies “Don’t Know What They’re Doing”
item.description: Daryl Hall has watched the music world change in ways he never thought possible. He has observed that radio no longer holds the same importance, especially for younger audiences—including his own children. People no longer wait for albums or singles to be released.
